# Security policy

If you discover a security vulnerability in Navire, please report it privately.
Do not open a public issue.

## Reporting a vulnerability

You can use a [private GitHub security advisory](https://github.com/navire-dev/navire/security/advisories/new) or email [security@nexacloud.dev](mailto:security@nexacloud.dev).

Please include the affected version or commit, the impact, reproduction steps, and any relevant logs with secrets removed.

The maintainers aim to acknowledge reports within 72 hours.

## Review process

The maintainers will assess the report, confirm its scope, prepare a fix, and coordinate disclosure after a patch is available.

Confirmed vulnerabilities may result in:

- a GitHub security advisory
- a patched release
- coordinated public disclosure

## Supported versions

Navire is currently under active development and does not yet publish stable releases.

Security fixes are applied to the latest supported release. When practical, security fixes are backported to maintained release lines. Users should upgrade to the latest available release whenever possible.

See the [release history](https://github.com/navire-dev/navire/releases) for available versions.
